scenes.name: AN AREA FULL OF PI
lines: To average over the three-sphere, a textbook divides by its area: two pi squared.
要在三维球面上求平均，教科书得除以它的面积：2π²。
Yet every polynomial average comes out a plain fraction. Where did the pi go?
可每个多项式的平均都是一个普通分数。π 到哪里去了？

scenes.name: TWO ROUTES
lines: Take one Gaussian integral in four dimensions, and compute it two ways.
取四维空间里的同一个高斯积分，用两种办法来算。
Axis by axis, each coordinate brings one root pi. Four of them make pi squared.
逐轴分离：每个坐标带进一个 √π，四个凑成 π²。
In polar form, the radius gives m plus one factorial over two; the area, two pi squared.
换成极坐标：径向给出 (m + 1)!/2，面积给出 2π²。
Both carry exactly pi squared. Strike it, and a ratio of factorials is left.
两条路恰好都带着 π²。把它划掉，只剩下阶乘之比。

scenes.name: WHY FOUR
lines: The circle cancels pi but is commutative; the two-sphere keeps a root pi and is no group.
圆周上 π 也会对消，但它是交换群；二维球面留下一个 √π，而且根本不是群。
Only the three-sphere is a non-commutative group whose pi cancels into whole factorials.
只有三维球面既是非交换群，π 又恰好对消成整数阶乘。

scenes.name: A FACTORIAL RULE
lines: So make the answer the definition: a monomial's average is this ratio of factorials.
那就把答案直接当作定义：单项式的平均，就是这个阶乘之比。
Odd powers are set to zero, as a sign flip demands.
奇次幂一律记为零，这是翻转坐标符号的要求。
The test: multiply by the sum of the four squares. The four steps add to one.
考验：乘上四个平方之和，结果不许变。四个步进比加起来恰好是 1。
By hand: four times one eighth, plus twelve times one twenty-fourth, is one.

scenes.name: CATALAN LADDER
lines: Now average powers of kappa, the first coordinate squared. Each moment is the last times a small fraction.
现在对 κ 的幂求平均，κ 是第一个坐标的平方。每一阶矩都是前一阶乘上一个小分数。
One, a quarter, an eighth, five sixty-fourths, seven over one hundred twenty-eight.
Times four to the k, they are Catalan numbers: one, one, two, five, fourteen.
乘上 4 的 k 次方，就是卡塔兰数：1，1，2，5，14。
Lean checks that step for every k, by whole-number cross-multiplication.
Lean 内核对每个 k 检验这一步，只用整数交叉相乘。

scenes.name: SHELLS AT RIGHT ANGLES
lines: The whole-spin characters are polynomials in kappa: one, four kappa minus one, a quadratic.
整数自旋特征标是 κ 的多项式：1，4κ − 1，再加一个二次式。
Pair the last two through the moments: five, minus eight, plus four, minus one. Exactly zero.
用这些矩给后两者配对：5 − 8 + 4 − 1，恰好是 0。
The quadratic with itself: fourteen, minus thirty, plus twenty-two, minus six, plus one. Exactly one.
Every denominator clears. Lean checks all six entries of this identity table.
分母全部消尽。Lean 内核检验了这张单位表的全部六项。

scenes.name: EVERY DEGREE
lines: Lean goes further: every even character above the constant averages to zero.
Lean 更进一步：常数以上的每个偶次特征标，平均恰好为零。
A product of two shells is a run of shells, from the gap of m and n to their sum.
两层壳之积是一串连续的壳，从 m 与 n 之差排到二者之和。
Average it: only shell zero survives, and only when m equals n is it in the run.
对它求平均：只有第零层能留下，而它只在 m = n 时才在串里。
So shells of every degree are orthonormal: no pi, no limits, no real numbers.
于是各阶壳层全部正交归一：没有 π，没有极限，也没有实数。

scenes.name: THE THRESHOLD
lines: Some roots still force their way in: making one, one, zero, zero a unit needs root two.
有些根号仍会挤进来：把 (1, 1, 0, 0) 缩成单位长，需要 √2。
Bell's quantum ceiling is two root two; the golden pentagon needs root five.
贝尔游戏的量子上限是 2√2；黄金五边形需要 √5。
The next chapter keeps each such root as a pair of fractions.
下一章把每个这样的根号记成一对分数。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Averages without pi: a factorial rule, an exact ladder, shells at right angles.
不用 π 的平均：一条阶乘规则，一架精确的阶梯，一组彼此垂直的壳层。
